supersedes: The current public effect metric Delta r=P(error|m,R)-P(error|m) frozen in A3/A4.
scientific_correction: Heralding evidence composes as an odds ratio, or additively as a difference of error log-odds; a raw probability difference is not the canonical evidence coordinate.

frozen_effect.shift: Delta ell_a=ell_a(m,R)-ell_a(m)=w_a(m)-w_a(m,R), where w is the no-error/error matching LLR
frozen_effect.visual_convention: red for positive Delta ell_a, blue for negative Delta ell_a, width proportional to |Delta ell_a| relative to the current sample maximum

scope: Global Wiki definition and visualization description
Lab 006 artifact payload, legend, edge layer, inspector, and summary statistic
Lab 006 concise report and plan wording
deterministic backend and exact rendered-surface tests
acceptance_gates: The backend computes Delta ell from the same clipped LLR weights consumed by matching.
The no-symmetry arm has identically zero Delta ell.
The artifact uses Delta ell, not Delta probability, for effect color, width, tooltip, inspector, and mean magnitude.
Positive Delta ell means R increases error odds and is red; negative Delta ell means R decreases error odds and is blue.
The Wiki derives Delta ell as a log Bayes factor and explains its odds-ratio interpretation.
The exact Lab Results page and Wiki page render the corrected convention without stale Delta-r labels.
Existing syndrome-fidelity, determinism, and BP tests continue to pass.
sampling: No new scientific sampling; deterministic fixed-seed payload and rendered-surface remediation only.
stop_rule: Fail closed if any current user-facing effect layer still presents a raw posterior-probability difference as the heralding effect.

verification.backend_identity: Delta ell equals m-only matching weight minus full-record matching weight exactly on the fixed-seed payload
